blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.
blocks.zh: 解剖连续性为医疗图像修复提供了补充信息,但其使用需要考虑局部解剖学和切片采样的变化. 我们引入了ContiLNN,它用双向闭式连续时间(Bi-CfC)模块来增强二维恢复主干线,用于交叉切片模型,同时保留飞机中的特性提取. 切片-索引间隔调节由本地特征和隐藏状态决定的门,使传播能够在没有数字ODE集成的情况下对取样变化作出反应。 参照制式一致性将第一阶和第二阶的交叉切片强度差异协调起来,以保持解剖变异,而冷冻骨干中的蒸馏有助于保持飞机中的忠诚。 在五种训练种子中,ContiLNN分别将PSNR比RWKV改进0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB,用于CT解毒、核磁共振超分辨率和减数PET恢复,在所有三项任务中RMSE都较低。 CT结果对于一个被搁置的病人来说是描述性的. PET分解支持命令传播超过额外点定能力。 在毗连式训练下,Bi-CfC的忠诚度高于具有类似参数计数和计算成本的Bi-GRU在所有测试取样条件下的忠诚度。 匹配的七片剖面显示比Bi-GRU低52.8%的延迟度和57.0%的峰值GPU内存使用率. 混合差距培训使两个操作人员的工作表现更加简陋和不规则,没有在衡量尺度和背景上进行统一的排名。 训练病人较少的实验和第二个骨干进一步支持数据效率和骨干兼容性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image restoration seeks to recover anatomical information from acquisitions constrained by radiation dose, scan duration or signal availability. Lower-dose CT reduces radiation exposure at the cost of increased noise ( McCollough et al., 2017 ; Moen et al., 2021 ) . In MRI, higher spatial resolution competes with acquisition time and signal-to-noise ratio, motivating super-resolution methods that recover structural detail from lower-resolution observations ( Chatterjee et al., 2024 ) . In PET, lower administered tracer activity can reduce radiation exposure, and shorter acquisitions can reduce scan burden; both reduce detected counts, increasing noise and making local uptake differences harder to distinguish ( Jang et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2022 ) . These tasks estimate high-quality (HQ) images from low-quality (LQ) inputs. Advances in convolutional, Transformer and state-space networks have substantially improved in-plane recovery, providing efficient backbones for a range of medical restoration tasks ( Zamir et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Chan et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 医疗图像修复试图从受辐射剂量、扫描时间或信号可用性所限制的获取中恢复解剖信息。 低剂量CT以增加噪音为代价来减少辐射照射(McCollow等,2017;Moen等,2021). 在核磁共振中,更高的空间分辨率与获取时间和信号-噪声比相竞争,激发超分辨率方法从下分辨率观测中恢复结构细节(Chatterjee等,2024年). 在PET中,管理较少的微量活性可以减少辐射照射,较短的获取可以减少扫描负担;既会减少被测出的数量,会增加噪音并更难区分局部吸收差异(Jang等人,2024;Luo等人,2022)。 这些任务从低质量(LQ)投入中估计出高质量的(HQ)图像. 革命、变形器和国有空间网络的进展大大改善了飞机内恢复,为一系列医疗修复任务提供了有效的骨干(Zamir等,2022;Yang等,2026a; Chan等, 2026; Yang等, 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. 2024; Chen等, 2026; Yang等, 2026b.).

blocks.en: The anatomical evidence in a volume extends beyond any individual slice. Adjacent images sample structures that evolve along the slice axis, yet independent two-dimensional (2D) processing does not explicitly retain this ordered relationship (Fig. 1 A). The imbalance between in-plane and through-plane information is a recognized challenge in volumetric medical image modeling ( Dong et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 解剖学证据的体积超出任何单个切片。 相邻的图像样本结构沿切片轴演化而来,然而独立的二维(2D)处理并没有明确地保留这种被命令的关系(图1 A). 飞机内和飞机内信息之间的不平衡是体积医学图像模型的公认挑战(Dong等,2022年)。

blocks.en: A relevant clinical application arises when only a subset of slices from an existing image series is available for retrospective restoration. The available slices may be regularly or irregularly spaced in the original index sequence, so adjacent inputs need not correspond to consecutive slices in the source series. Their original indices preserve this distinction. This setting motivates cross-slice feature propagation that uses neighboring anatomy while accounting for the index gaps between available observations, with a restored output retained at each supplied position.
blocks.zh: 当现有图像系列中只有一分片可供追溯恢复时,就会产生相关的临床应用. 可用的切片可能在原始索引序列中被定期或不规则地间隔,因此相邻输入不需要对应源序列中相接的切片. 它们的原始指数保持了这种区别。 这种设置激发了交叉切片特性的传播,这种特性使用相邻的解剖学,同时计算现有观测数据之间的指数差距,每个提供位置保留一个恢复的输出。

blocks.en: Local 2.5D modeling combines in-plane feature extraction with information from neighboring slices. Three-dimensional (3D) restoration networks instead model context through volumetric feature maps, as in convolutional models for MRI super-resolution ( Chatterjee et al., 2024 ) and Spach Transformer for PET denoising ( Jang et al., 2024 ) . Storage for these feature maps scales with their spatial extent and channel width. Neighboring CT slices have also been incorporated into convolutional encoder–decoders ( Shan et al., 2018 ) . Adjacent-slice supervision and multi-view inference provide further ways to use through-plane information ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . These approaches establish several roles for local anatomical context. ContiLNN represents this context as an evolving sequence of feature states, with an explicit slice-index interval and a restored output at every supplied position.
blocks.zh: 本地的2.5D建模结合了从相邻切片中提取的飞机内地物特征. 三维(3D)还原网络取而代之的是通过量子特征图的模型上下文,如MRI超分辨率(Chatterjee等,2024年)和PET去诺化(Jang等,2024年)的Spach变形器的演化模型. 这些地物图的空间范围及信道宽度都用于存储. 相邻的CT切片也已经被收录入了革命编码器-解码器(Shan等,2018年). 相邻-剪切监督和多视角推论提供了通过平面信息使用的进一步方式(张等,2021;陈等,2025.). 这些方法为地方解剖环境确立了若干作用。 孔蒂语 LNN代表了这个上下文,作为演化的特征状态序列,每个提供位置都有明确的切入索引间隔并恢复输出.

blocks.en: Liquid neural networks provide a continuous-time model of input-dependent state evolution ( Hasani et al., 2021 ) . Closed-form continuous-time networks (CfCs) approximate this evolution through interval-dependent updates without repeated numerical integration ( Hasani et al., 2022 ) . Their explicit interval input is particularly relevant when the separation between observations varies. For medical image restoration, we propagate states in slice order and condition each update on a normalized slice-index interval. Forward and backward states then communicate information between preceding and following observations (Fig. 1 B). This links the anatomical ordering of the input to the dynamics used to refine its features.
blocks.zh: 液态神经网络为输入依赖状态进化提供了连续时间模型(Hasani等,2021. 封闭式连续时间网络(CfCs)通过不重复数字集成而依赖间隔的更新来估计这种演变(Hasani等,2022.). 当观测之间的分离情况不同时,它们的明确间隔输入特别相关。 为了恢复医疗图像,我们按片段顺序传播状态,并按正常的片段指数间隔进行每次更新。 前进状态和后向状态然后在前后观测之间传递信息(图1 B). 这把输入的解剖顺序与用来完善其特征的动态联系起来.

blocks.en: Here we introduce ContiLNN, which augments 2D restoration backbones with bidirectional liquid dynamics along the slice axis. Each local sequence retains the correspondence between its input slices and restored outputs (Fig. 1 C). Bidirectional CfC (Bi-CfC) modules propagate context at selected levels of the feature hierarchy, while two complementary regularizers guide the resulting images: cross-slice consistency preserves first- and second-order intensity changes in the HQ sequence, and distillation from a frozen 2D backbone retains agreement with its in-plane estimates. We develop this design on Restore-RWKV ( Yang et al., 2026a ) and apply it to DASMamba ( Chan et al., 2026 ) to examine compatibility with a second backbone.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们引入了ContiLNN,它用双向液态动力学在切片轴上增强2D还原骨干. 每个局部序列保留其输入切片与还原输出(图1 C)之间的对应. 双向 CfC (Bi-CfC) 模块在特征分级的选定级别上传播上下文,而两个互补的正则器则指导由此产生的图像:相切一致性保留了HQ序列的一阶和二阶强度变化,从被冷冻的2D主干线中分馏保留与其平面中估计的一致. 我们开发了这个关于Return-RWKV(Yang等,2026a)的设计,并将其应用于DASMamba(Chan等,2026年),以审查与第二个骨干兼容性.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: 1. Liquid dynamics for medical image restoration. We introduce ContiLNN to propagate anatomical information across ordered slices through bidirectional liquid dynamics. Slice-index intervals condition the closed-form updates, allowing state propagation to respond to sampling changes. 2. Augmentation of 2D restoration backbones. Bi-CfC modules refine selected feature pathways while retaining the backbone’s in-plane blocks. Cross-slice intensity consistency and 2D backbone distillation jointly preserve reference anatomical variation and in-plane fidelity. 3. Evaluation across modalities and sampling settings. CT, MRI and PET experiments assess restoration quality. Case-level analyses, comparisons of two operators under regular, sparse and irregular sampling, limited-patient training, backbone studies and ablations assess sampling adaptation, data efficiency and backbone compatibility.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 用于医疗图像修复的液体动力学。 我们引入了ContiLNN,通过双向液体动力学将解剖信息传播到订购的切片上. 切片-索引间隔条件为封闭式更新,允许状态传播响应采样变化. 2.加强2D修复骨干. Bi-CfC模块在保留主干线的平面块的同时,完善了选定的特性路径. 交叉切片强度一致性和2D骨干蒸馏法共同保存了参考解剖变异和机上忠心. 3. 跨模式和取样环境的评价。 CT,核磁共振和PET实验评估还原质量. 案例分析、在定期、稀少和不规则的抽样下比较两个操作人员、有限病人培训、骨干研究和模拟评估取样适应性、数据效率和骨干兼容性。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical image restoration
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗图像修复

blocks.en: Learning-based restoration has progressed from local residual prediction to efficient modeling of long-range image structure. Convolutional restoration networks learn local image priors from paired images or neighboring observations ( Shan et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ) . Transformer models extend the spatial reach of these representations through attention, improving the recovery of fine structures and long-range dependencies ( Liang et al., 2021 ; Zamir et al., 2022 ) . RWKV combines recurrent inference with parallelizable training, and its visual adaptations provide another route to efficient spatial modeling ( Peng et al., 2023 ; Duan et al., 2025 ) . MambaIR, DenoMamba, CT-Mamba, Restore-RWKV and DASMamba apply state-space or recurrent-style representations to natural and medical image restoration ( Gu and Dao, 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Öztürk et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Chan et al., 2026 ) . These methods supply the in-plane feature hierarchies on which ContiLNN builds. Whereas our previous work FedFTN ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) addresses institutional heterogeneity through personalized federated learning for low-count PET denoising, ContiLNN models cross-slice anatomical context through interval-conditioned bidirectional liquid dynamics for CT, MRI, and PET restoration.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的修复工作已从局部残余预测向高效的长距离图像结构模型化发展. 革命修复网络从配对图像或相邻观测中学习本地图像前身(Shan等,2018;张等,2021). 变形器模型通过关注来扩大这些表示的空间范围,改善精细结构和远距离依赖性的恢复(梁等,2021;Zamir等,2022.). RWKV将反复推论与可平行的训练相结合,其视觉改造为高效的空间建模提供了另一条途径(Peng等,2023;Duan等,2025.). blocks.en: 2.2 Slice-axis context
blocks.zh: 2.2 剪切轴上下文

blocks.en: The choice of spatial representation determines how neighboring slices contribute to a prediction. Slice-wise networks are compatible with high-resolution images, whereas volumetric networks directly couple in-plane and through-plane structure. Anisotropic sampling complicates this balance because a fixed number of neighboring slices can span substantially different anatomical extents ( Dong et al., 2022 ) . Consequently, slice count alone does not describe the context available to a model; the sampling intervals also matter.
blocks.zh: 空间代表的选择决定了相邻的切片如何为预测作出贡献. 切片网络与高分辨率图像相容,而量子网络直接对接飞机和飞机结构。 异同位素取样使这种平衡复杂化,因为固定数量的相邻切片可以覆盖非常不同的解剖范围(Dong等人,2022年)。 因此,单是切片计数并不能描述模型可用的上下文;取样间隔也很重要。

blocks.en: Restoration methods use through-plane information in several distinct ways. Hybrid 2D/3D convolution can aggregate neighboring CT slices for center-slice denoising ( Shan et al., 2018 ) , while volumetric MRI networks learn features across all three spatial axes for super-resolution ( Chatterjee et al., 2024 ) . Other approaches use adjacent slices as training supervision or combine predictions from multiple views ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Slice-based reconstruction addresses a related problem by recovering volumes or anatomical surfaces from sparse observations ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) . ContiLNN maintains an ordered feature sequence and restores every supplied slice. Its interval inputs are derived from the original index gaps between selected observations, allowing feature updates to respond to both local image content and the sampling of neighboring context.
blocks.zh: 恢复方法以几种不同的方式通过飞机使用信息。 Hybrid 2D/3D 折射可以聚合相邻的 CT 切片来进行中切除(Shan等,2018年),而量子核磁共振网络则会学习所有三个空间轴的特性来进行超解(Chatterjee等,2024年). 其他方法使用相邻切片作为培训监督或结合多种观点的预测(张等,2021;陈等,2025.). 基于切片的重建通过从稀少的观测中取回体积或解剖表面来解决一个相关问题(徐等,2023;萧等,2025.). ContiLNN 维持一个命令的特征序列,并恢复每个供应的切片. 其间隔输入来源于所选观测数据之间的原始索引缺口,允许特性更新既响应本地图像内容,又响应相邻上下文的采样.

blocks.en: 2.3 Liquid neural dynamics
blocks.zh: 2.3 液体神经动态

blocks.en: Continuous-time models describe how a hidden representation evolves between observations. Neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) express this evolution through a learned vector field ( Chen et al., 2018 ) , while latent ODE models provide continuous-time latent representations for irregularly observed sequences ( Rubanova et al., 2019 ) . Liquid time-constant networks introduce input-dependent dynamics, allowing the effective transition to vary with the observation ( Hasani et al., 2021 ) . CfCs approximate these dynamics with closed-form updates that retain an explicit dependence on the supplied interval ( Hasani et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 连续时间模型描述一种隐藏的表达方式如何在观测之间演变. 神经普通微分方程(ODEs)通过一个有学问的向量场(Chen等,2018年)来表达这种演化,而潜伏的ODE模型则为不规则观测到的序列提供了连续的潜想表示(Rubanova等,2019年). 液态时常网络引入了依赖输入的动态,使得有效过渡随观测结果而变化(Hasani等,2021年). CfCs将这些动态与封闭式更新相近,这些更新保留了对所提供间隔的明确依赖(Hasani等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: This dependence offers a useful connection between continuous-time modeling and slice sampling. An update can respond to a larger index gap without treating it as the same transition as two consecutive slices. ContiLNN applies this principle to dense features at corresponding in-plane locations, with two directions of propagation supplying complementary anatomical context. We evaluate Bi-CfC across sparse and irregular neighboring contexts after contiguous training, and investigate mixed-gap training separately as a way to broaden exposure to sampling variations.
blocks.zh: 这种依赖性提供了连续时间模型和切片采样之间的有益联系. 更新可以应对更大的指数差距,而不将其作为与连续两个切片相同的过渡. 孔蒂语 LNN将这一原则适用于相应的飞机内地点的密集地貌,其传播方向有两个,即提供互补解剖背景。 我们通过连接培训,对邻近地区稀有和不规则的环境进行双脂蛋白(Bi-CfC)评价,并单独调查混合脂蛋白(bix-gap training)培训,以此扩大对取样变化的接触。

blocks.en: 2.4 Consistency and distillation
blocks.zh: 2.4 一致性和蒸馏性

blocks.en: Consistency regularization encourages agreement under input or model perturbations ( Tarvainen and Valpola, 2017 ; Laine and Aila, 2017 ) , while knowledge distillation transfers information through predictions from a reference model ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) . In restoration, these constraints complement direct fidelity to the reference image. For an ordered slice sequence, neighboring reference images need not have identical intensities: anatomical boundaries and uptake patterns can change substantially with position. We therefore match the first- and second-order differences of restored and reference sequences. A separate 2D backbone distillation term encourages agreement with predictions from a frozen, pretrained 2D backbone. These two forms of regularization preserve useful in-plane estimates while learning the additional information supplied by neighboring slices.

blocks.en: Restore-RWKV supplies the principal backbone, with Bi-CfC augmenting its intermediate encoder and decoder blocks, selected skips, bottleneck and late refinement pathway. The same insertion roles are applied to DASMamba to examine backbone compatibility. Supplementary Section A reports the representative Restore-RWKV topology and module settings. This design enables slice-axis modeling within existing feature hierarchies while keeping sequence propagation local to one patient or scan.

blocks.en: The selected pathways address different stages of restoration. Intermediate encoder and decoder features provide reduced-resolution representations that retain local structure for cross-slice exchange. Skip-path modules carry this context from encoding to decoding, while serial bottleneck processing makes the deepest representation sequence-aware before upsampling. The late refinement pathway supplies a final contextual correction. Gates regulate the contribution of the transformed sequence features along the remaining pathways, allowing their strength to be learned jointly with the in-plane backbone.
blocks.zh: 选定的路径涉及恢复的不同阶段。 中间编码器和解码器的特性提供分解度降低的表示,保留了相切交换的局部结构. Skip-path模块承载了从编码到解码的上下文,而串行瓶颈处理则在上标前使表达序列-意识最深. 迟到的完善路径提供了最后的背景更正。 盖茨规范了改变后序列特征在剩余路径上的贡献,使得它们的力量能够被与飞机上的主干线共同学习.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate anatomical restoration across three modalities with distinct degradations: CT denoising, MRI super-resolution and reduced-count PET restoration. The case-disjoint partitions and preprocessing follow the established restoration benchmarks ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Chan et al., 2026 ) . Low-quality (LQ) and high-quality (HQ) images denote the degraded input and paired reference, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了三种具有明显退化模式的解剖修复:CT去诺化、核磁共振超解析和减量PET修复。 案件分开分割和预处理遵循既定的恢复基准(Yang等,2026a; Chan等, 2026 (英语). 低质量(LQ)和高品质(HQ)图像分别表示已退化的输入和成对的参考.

blocks.en: The CT benchmark derives from the ten-patient training set released for the American Association of Physicists in Medicine (AAPM) Low Dose CT Grand Challenge, which provides paired quarter-dose and normal-dose images ( McCollough et al., 2017 ) . The training, validation and test partitions contain eight, one and one patients, respectively, with 2,039, 128 and 211 slices. Quarter-dose images serve as inputs and normal-dose images as references.
blocks.zh: CT基准来源于美国医学物理学家协会(AAPM)"低剂量CT大挑战"(Low Dose CT Grand Challenge)发布的十位患者培训集,该集提供配对的四分之一剂量和正常剂量图像(McCollow等,2017年). 训练,鉴定和试验分会分别收有8名,1名和1名病人,分会2,039分会,128分会和211分会. 四分之一剂量的图像作为投入,而正常剂量的图像作为参考。

blocks.en: For MRI, we use T2-weighted images from IXI ( IXI Project, n.d. ) . The source allocation is 405/59/114 subjects for training/validation/testing, yielding 40,500/5,828/11,400 available slices; the validation reader supplies 58 readable subjects, as detailed in Supplementary Section A. LQ images are reconstructed after retaining the central 6.25% of two-dimensional k-space, corresponding to four-fold degradation along each in-plane axis. The slice-axis sampling is retained in this super-resolution task.
blocks.zh: 对于核磁共振,我们使用九一(九一项目)的T2加权图像。 来源分配为405/59/114个培训/验证/测试科目,可选取40,500/5,828/11,400块;验证阅读器提供58个可读科目,详见补充部分A. LQ图像在保留了6.25%的二维克空间后重建,相当于每平面轴上四倍的降解. 切片轴取样被保留在这个超分辨率任务中.

blocks.en: The PET cohort comprises 159 scans acquired with a PolarStar m660 system, originating from the dataset described by Yang et al. (2024) . The training, validation and test partitions contain 120, ten and 29 scans, respectively. After exclusion of air-only slices, these partitions contain 8,350/684/2,044 paired images. Reduced-count inputs are generated from list-mode data with a reduction factor of 12. Modality-specific intensity normalization and evaluation windows are specified in Supplementary Section A.
blocks.zh: PET组包括用极地星m660系统获得的159个扫描器,来源于杨等所描述的数据集(2024年). 培训、验证和测试分区分别包含120个、10个和29个扫描。 在排除了只空气片后,这些分区包含有8,350/684/2,044对映相. 从列表模式数据中产生减少的计算投入,减少系数为12。 A部分在补充部分中具体规定了针对模式的强度正常化和评价窗口。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验装置

blocks.en: We reproduce the 2D backbones using their released training procedures and initialize ContiLNN from the checkpoint with the highest validation score. A frozen copy of the corresponding backbone supplies predictions for 2D backbone distillation, while the ContiLNN backbone and Bi-CfC modules are trained jointly. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the architecture augments in-plane feature extraction with slice-axis propagation and uses the frozen backbone only to guide training. Contiguous slice windows are used for the principal restoration results in Table 1 and the operator comparisons in Tables 2 and 5 ; mixed-gap training is investigated separately in Supplementary Section H. The representative ContiLNN-RWKV optimization settings, window configurations and loss weights are collected in Supplementary Section A, together with the common workflow used for DASMamba.
blocks.zh: 我们使用2D骨干复制其发布的训练程序,并将ContiLNN从检查站初始化,获得最高的验证分. 冷冻了相应的骨干供应预测2D骨干蒸馏,而ContiLNN骨干和Bi-CfC模块则联合培训. 如图2所说明的,该建筑用片轴传播增强飞机内地物提取,并使用被冻结的骨干来指导培训。 表1的主要恢复结果和表2和表5的操作员比较使用了相接的切片窗;补充部分H单独调查了混合差距培训。 代表性ContiLNN-RWKV优化设置,窗口配置和减重与DASMamba通用工作流程一起被收集到A补充部分.

blocks.en: Restoration quality is measured using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), the structural similarity index measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and root mean squared error (RMSE). Metrics are calculated in the modality’s restored intensity scale, averaged within each patient or scan, and then averaged across cases with equal weight. ContiLNN estimates in Table 1 are means and sample standard deviations (SDs) across five training seeds. Case-level statistical analyses are presented separately below. CT results describe the single held-out patient in its benchmark partition.
blocks.zh: 恢复质量采用峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR),结构相近指数度量(SSIM)(Wang等,2004年),根正平方差(RMSE)等测量. 量子按模式的恢复强度尺度计算,每个病人或扫描的平均值,然后按体重相等的病例平均。 孔蒂语 表1中的LNN估计数是5个培训种子的路由和抽样标准差。 个案一级的统计分析另列如下。 CT结果描述了单人被搁置的患者在其基准分出.

blocks.en: Table 2: Bi-CfC and Bi-GRU under contiguous training on the 29-case PET test cohort. Both variants use the same insertion sites, objective and training budget. The slice-index gap g g specifies the separation between neighboring observations; irregular windows mix g ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } g\in\{1,2,3\} . All settings evaluate the same original target slices with different neighboring context. Bold indicates the better operator within each test condition.
blocks.zh: 表2:对29个案例的PET测试组进行连续培训的双CfC和双GRU。 两种变体都使用相同的插入站点、目标和培训预算。 切入- index 差距 g 指定了相邻观测之间的分隔; 不规则窗口混合 g {{ 1, 2, 3} g\\\ 1, 2, 3} 。 所有设置都以不同的相邻上下文评价相同的原始目标切片. 粗体表示每个试验条件下的操作人员更好。

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative results
blocks.zh: 4.3 量化结果

blocks.en: Ordered slice-axis modeling improves fidelity across the three evaluated restoration tasks (Table 1 ). Relative to Restore-RWKV, mean PSNR increases by 0.1907, 1.0176 and 1.2482 dB on CT, MRI and PET, respectively, accompanied by higher SSIM and lower RMSE. The agreement across these metrics connects the use of neighboring anatomy with improved intensity accuracy and structural fidelity. On the held-out CT patient, the improvement is consistent across training seeds, with a PSNR SD of 0.0026 dB.
blocks.zh: 订购的切片轴模型提高了三个评估修复任务的忠诚度(表1)。 相对于还原-RWKV,指PSNR在CT,核磁共振和PET上分别增加0.1907,1.0176和1.2482分贝,并伴有更高的SSIM和较低的RMSE. 横跨这些度量衡的协议将相邻解剖学的用法与增强强度精度和结构忠贞性联系起来. 在被搁置的CT患者身上,整个训练种子的改进一致,PSNR SD为0.0026分贝.

blocks.en: The improvements persist across the observed seed variation. Every ContiLNN-RWKV training seed yields higher PSNR and SSIM and lower RMSE than the baseline in each modality. At one SD below the mean, PSNR remains 0.19, 0.99 and 1.15 dB above the baseline for CT, MRI and PET, respectively. This separation indicates that the benefit of neighboring anatomical context is maintained across the evaluated initializations.
blocks.zh: 在观察到的种子变异中,情况继续得到改善。 每一种ContiLNN-RWKV训练种子的产量都比每种模式的基准值高。 在低于平均值的一个SD中,PSNR仍然分别高于CT、核磁共振和PET的基线0.19、0.99和1.15分贝。 这种分离表明,在经过评估的初始化过程中,邻接解剖环境的好处保持不变。

blocks.en: Integration with DASMamba supports the use of slice-axis dynamics with a second in-plane representation. Mean PSNR increases by 0.1934, 0.3604 and 1.1264 dB on CT, MRI and PET, respectively, with corresponding RMSE reductions of 0.1817, 1.0886 and 0.0095 (Table 1 ). PET also improves in SSIM, while the CT and MRI SSIM estimates are lower than those of their DASMamba baselines by 0.0051 and 0.0050, respectively. The consistent PSNR and RMSE improvements across both backbones support architectural compatibility, with the accompanying SSIM differences retained in the paired results.
blocks.zh: 与DASMamba的整合支持使用有第二个机上代表的切片轴动态. 在CT、核磁共振和PET上,平均PSNR分别增加0.1934、0.3604和1.1264分贝,相应的RMSE减少0.1817、1.0886和0.095(表1)。 PET在SSIM中也有改善,而CT和核磁共振SSIM的估计数分别低于其DASMamba基线的0.0051和0.0050. 两种主干一致的PSNR和RMSE改进支持了建筑兼容性,配对结果中保留了伴随的SSIM差异.

blocks.en: 4.4 Sampling robustness
blocks.zh: 4.4 取样稳健性

blocks.en: Bi-CfC is evaluated against Bi-GRU to examine restoration when neighboring slices are sparsely or irregularly available (Table 2 ). Both variants are trained on contiguous windows, retaining the same backbone initialization, insertion sites, full objective and training budget. At test time, sampling changes the neighboring context while preserving the original images, slice indices and evaluated target slices.
blocks.zh: 对Bi-CfC进行比对Bi-GRU的评价,以便在相邻的切片很少或不定期可用时审查恢复情况(表2)。 这两个变体都接受了关于相接窗口的培训,保留了相同的主干初始化,插入站点,完全目标化和培训预算. 在测试时,采样会改变相邻的上下文,同时保留原始的图像,切片指数和评价出的目标切片.

blocks.en: Uniform gaps g = 1 , 2 , 3 g=1,2,3 select consecutive, every second and every third slices, respectively. For full seven-slice irregular windows, the six transitions comprise two occurrences of each gap. Sparse evaluation uses interleaved slice sequences, whereas irregular evaluation combines overlapping windows; both protocols retain the same eligible targets across the 29 test cases.
blocks.zh: 统一差克=1分,2分,3克=1,2,3分相接选择,每秒和每分之三分别选择. 对于完整的七片不规则窗口,六个过渡包含每个缺口的两个出错. Sparse评价采用互放的切片序列,而不规则的评价结合了相重叠的窗口;在29个测试案例中,两个协议都保留了相同的合格目标.

blocks.en: Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher PSNR and SSIM and lower RMSE than Bi-GRU in all four test contexts (Table 2 ; Supplementary Fig. S6A). Its PSNR advantage increases from 0.0693 dB at g = 1 g=1 to 0.1357 dB at g = 3 g=3 . Relative to each operator’s g = 1 g=1 result, PSNR decreases by 1.9216 dB for Bi-CfC and 1.9881 dB for Bi-GRU at g = 3 g=3 , indicating modestly smaller degradation as neighboring observations become more widely separated. Bi-CfC also has lower measured latency and peak allocated memory than Bi-GRU under the common profiling workload (Table 4 ; Supplementary Fig. S6B).
blocks.zh: 在相接训练下,Bi-CfC在所有四个测试情况下都实现了比Bi-GRU更高的PSNR和SSIM,并低于RMSE(表2;补充图S6A). 其PSNR的优势从克=一克的0.0693分贝增加到克=三克的0.1357分贝. 相较于每个操作者的克=1克=1结果,PSNR将Bi-CfC减少1.9216分贝,而将Bi-GRU减少1.9881分贝为克=3克=3分贝,表明随着相邻观测物被更广泛地分离,降解程度略小. Bi-CfC在常见的剖面工作负荷下,比起Bi-GRU(表4;补充图.S6B),测量的耐久性和所分配的顶峰内存也较低.

blocks.en: An additional mixed-gap study examines whether exposure to varied sampling gaps improves restoration under altered neighboring context. Both operators benefit under sparse and irregular conditions, with no uniform ranking across metrics and contexts after mixed-gap training (Supplementary Section H).
blocks.zh: 另一项混合差距研究考察了在改变的相邻环境下,接触各种取样差距是否改善恢复。 两家运营商在稀有和不规则的条件下受益,在混合差距培训之后,在计量和背景方面没有统一的排名(补充H节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Restoration examples for (A) CT, (B) MRI and (C) PET, with two examples per modality. Columns contain LQ inputs, Restore-RWKV and ContiLNN outputs, HQ references (ground truth, GT), and error-reduction maps. Boxed regions are enlarged below; orange arrows identify corresponding local structures and intensity transitions. Brighter colors indicate larger positive reductions in absolute error relative to Restore-RWKV, measured in normalized display intensity. Error increases are clipped to zero. Each modality shares one color scale; display masking and saturation settings are given in Supplementary Section A.

blocks.en: Table 3: PET restoration with 5% and 10% of the training patients. Patient subsets are nested, with the validation and test cohorts unchanged. Budget-matched training uses the same number of slice presentations as Restore-RWKV; full refinement adds optimization on the same patient subset. Bold highlights the ContiLNN results.

blocks.en: 4.5 Data efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 数据效率

blocks.en: Limited paired cohorts provide a second test of the information contributed by neighboring anatomy. We train PET models using nested subsets of six and 12 patients, corresponding to 5% and 10% of the training cohort, while retaining the full validation and test partitions (Table 3 ). Budget-matched training assigns the same total number of target-slice presentations to Restore-RWKV and ContiLNN. Full refinement additionally trains the sequence model from the corresponding 2D checkpoint; both strategies use the same patients. Exposure budgets and schedules are detailed in Supplementary Section A.
blocks.zh: 有限的对等组群对邻接解剖学提供的信息提供了第二次测试. 我们使用由6名和12名患者组成的嵌入子集来训练PET模型,相当于培训组群的5%和10%,同时保留完整的验证和测试分区(表3)。 与预算相匹配的培训为RWKV和ContiLNN提供同样数量的针对性介绍。 全面完善后,再从相应的2D检查点对序列模型进行培训;两种策略都使用同一种患者. 接触预算和时间表详见补充A节。

blocks.en: Under the matched target-slice exposure budget, ContiLNN improves PSNR by 0.5914 and 0.5889 dB at the 5% and 10% patient fractions, respectively, with higher SSIM and lower RMSE. Full refinement uses additional optimization on the same patient subsets and yields further PSNR and RMSE improvements. Its SSIM decreases at 5% and increases at 10% relative to matched-budget ContiLNN. The matched-budget results support improved use of limited paired data, while the separate refinement results describe the effect of additional optimization.
blocks.zh: 根据相应的目标切片接触预算,ContiLNN在5%和10%的病人分数中分别将PSNR改进了0.5914和0.5889分贝,增加了较高的SSIM和较低的RMSE. 全面完善在同一个患者子集上使用额外的优化,并产生进一步的PSNR和RMSE改进. 它的SSIM比对应预算的ContiLNN下降5%并增加10%. 对应预算结果支持改进有限配对数据的使用,而单独的完善结果则说明了额外优化的效果。

blocks.en: 4.6 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: 4.6 定性结果

blocks.en: ContiLNN preserves local structure across the three modalities. The CT examples retain clearer soft-tissue interfaces and small high-contrast structures (Fig. 3 A). MRI contours follow the HQ reference more closely (Fig. 3 B), while PET uptake patterns show clearer local contrast (Fig. 3 C). The matched regions of interest and error maps locate these improvements.
blocks.zh: ContiLNN保留了三种方式的当地结构. CT的例子保留了更清晰的软-tission接口和小高相接结构(图3 A). 核磁共振轮廓更贴近总部参考(图3 B),而PET吸收模式则显示更清晰的局部对比(图3 C). 相匹配的感兴趣地区和出错地图找到这些改进。

blocks.en: Orthogonal MRI views extend this assessment beyond individual in-plane slices (Supplementary Section G, Figs. S4 and S5). The enlarged regions highlight narrow tissue interfaces and branching boundaries in both the H–W and D-axis views; ContiLNN follows their HQ appearance more closely than Restore-RWKV in these selected regions. The D–W and D–H reformats retain all 100 processed slices, allowing these local structures to be examined across the available slice sequence.
blocks.zh: 轨道磁共振观点将这一评估范围扩大到单个飞机内切片之外(补充部分G,图S4和S5)。 扩大的区域突出显示H-W和D-轴的狭窄组织界面和分界线; ContiLNN在这些选定的区域比Return-RWKV更接近其总部外观。 D-W和D-H重塑机保留了所有100个已加工的片段,使这些局部结构能够在现有的片段序列中进行检查。

blocks.en: Boundary regions provide a focused assessment of cross-slice continuity: as anatomy varies along the slice axis, the relative contributions of neighboring tissues within a fixed local region change, producing intensity transitions that a restoration model should preserve. We examine three locations (P1–P3) in each modality (Fig. 4 ). In CT, P1 and P3 lie near posterior paraspinal soft-tissue boundaries, while P2 lies beside the vertebral body at a soft-tissue interface. In MRI, P1 and P3 sample soft-tissue interfaces near the skull base, and P2 samples a tissue–air interface in the nasal region. In PET, P1–P3 sample pelvic, abdominal and lateral body regions with distinct uptake contrasts. The profiles thus probe both relatively stable local intensities and more pronounced changes as structures pass through the sampled region.
blocks.zh: 边境地区对跨切片连续性提供了重点评估:由于解剖学沿切片轴不同,相邻组织在固定局部区域变化中的相对贡献,产生恢复模型应当保存的强度过渡. 我们审查每种模式的三个地点(P1-P-3)(图4)。 在CT中,P1和P3位于后寄生虫软质组织边界附近,而P2则位于软质组织界面的脊椎体旁边. 在核磁共振中,P1和P3样本软质组织介面靠近头骨基座,而P2样本是鼻部区域的一个组织-空气介面. 在PET中,P1-P3样本的盆腔,腹部和横向身体区域具有明显的吸收对比. 因此,这些剖面可探测到相对稳定的局部强度和随着结构穿过被取样区域而发生的更显著的变化。

blocks.en: Agreement with the reference involves preserving the level and shape of these intensity changes. At CT P2, ContiLNN reduces the intensity deviation across all seven positions, including the terminal drop in the baseline profile. At MRI P2, it follows the reference peak at relative position − 1 -1 and trough at + 1 +1 , retaining the sharp transition. At PET P3, it more closely follows the rise and subsequent decline in reference uptake. For these three displayed profiles, the mean absolute deviation from the reference over seven positions decreases from 0.290 to 0.135, from 0.150 to 0.066 and from 0.257 to 0.085, respectively, on the normalized intensity scale defined in the caption. Together, these examples link the visible boundary regions to reduced local intensity error and better preservation of reference variation along the slice axis.
blocks.zh: 同意这一提法涉及保持这些强度变化的水平和形状。 在CT P2上,ContiLNN会降低所有7个位置的强度偏差,包括基线剖面中的终端下降. 在核磁共振P2中,它跟随相对位置的参考峰值− 1 - 1,在+1 + 1 上槽,保留了锐地过渡. 在PET P3中,它更密切地跟踪参考吸收量的上升和随后的下降。 对于这三个显示的剖面图,在标题所定义的正常强度尺度上,7个以上位置的参考值平均绝对偏差分别从0.290降至0.135,从0.150降至0.066和从0.257降至0.085。 这些例子共同将可见的边界区域与减少局部强度误差和更好地保留切片轴的参考变量联系起来。

blocks.en: 4.7 Case-level analysis
blocks.zh: 4.7 个案分析

blocks.en: Restoration gains extend across the held-out MRI and PET cohorts. We analyze paired case-level differences from complete saved output volumes, defining positive differences as higher PSNR or SSIM and lower RMSE. Significance is evaluated with paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests ( Wilcoxon, 1945 ) and Holm adjustment across the six modality–metric tests ( Holm, 1979 ) . Median differences are accompanied by 95% case-bootstrap confidence intervals ( Efron, 1979 ) ; the evaluation settings are given in Supplementary Section A.
blocks.zh: 恢复收益遍及被搁置的核磁共振和核磁共振组群。 我们从完整保存的输出量中分析成对的大小写级别差异,将正差定义为更高的PSNR或SSIM和较低的RMSE. 意义通过双侧威尔科克逊签名排名测试(Wilcoxon,1945年)和Holm调整来评价,这些测试跨越了六种模式的计量测试(Holm,1979年)。 中度差异伴有95%的大小写置信间隔(Efron,1979年;评价设置见补充A节)。

blocks.en: All 114 MRI subjects and all 29 PET scans improve in PSNR, SSIM and RMSE (Fig. 6 A–D). Median PSNR gains are 1.0443 dB for MRI and 1.1711 dB for PET, with 95% confidence intervals of [1.0154, 1.0681] and [1.0636, 1.3666] dB, respectively (Fig. 6 E). Median SSIM increases are 0.0084 and 0.0060, and median absolute RMSE reductions are 2.0425 and 0.0104. All six adjusted p p values are below 1.2 × 10 − 8 1.2\times 10^{-8} . The distributions therefore associate the aggregate improvement with consistent case-level benefits throughout these two test cohorts.

blocks.en: Selective insertion adds 6.56 million parameters and 22.88 billion multiply–accumulate operations (GMACs) per slice to Restore-RWKV (Table 4 ). For a matched seven-image workload, the median forward time per slice increases by 8.97 ms, from 16.72 to 25.69 ms, while peak allocated inference memory changes from 987.00 to 995.03 MB. Per-slice time is amortized over one seven-slice forward pass; data loading and overlapping-window fusion are outside this measurement. Profiling uses the same device, precision and image dimensions, specified in Supplementary Section A.

blocks.en: A slice-independent multilayer perceptron (MLP) inserted at the same pathways has nearly identical model size and arithmetic cost to Bi-CfC. Its latency is lower, at 21.23 ms per slice, but its peak allocated memory is higher, at 1,835.22 MB. This resource profile enables an ablation of ordered propagation against a pointwise operator with closely matched capacity and computation.
blocks.zh: 在同一路径上插入的切片独立的多层受体(MLP)对Bi-CfC具有几乎相同的模型大小和算术成本. 其耐久性较低,为每片21.23ms,但其最高分配内存较高,为1,835.22 MB. 这种资源配置可以使命令的传播与具有紧密相匹配能力和计算能力的指针操作员相对应。

blocks.en: A bidirectional gated recurrent unit (Bi-GRU) alternative is evaluated under the same profiling conditions. Bi-GRU and Bi-CfC closely match in parameter count (34.91 versus 34.93 million) and arithmetic cost (423.51 versus 422.39 GMACs per window). Bi-CfC reduces median window latency from 380.92 to 179.85 ms (52.8%) and peak allocated memory from 2,315.80 to 995.03 MB (57.0%), showing that matched capacity and arithmetic cost do not imply matched execution cost.
blocks.zh: 对双向门式经常单元(Bi-GRU)的替代品在相同的剖面条件下进行评估。 Bi-GRU和Bi-CfC在参数计数(34.91对34.93万)和算术成本(423.51对422.39GMAC/每个窗口)中紧密匹配. Bi-CfC将窗口的中位休息从380.92米(52.8%)减少到179.85米(52.8%),最高分配的内存从2,315.80米减少到995.03米(57.0%),表明匹配的能力和算术成本并不意味着匹配的执行成本.

blocks.en: The PET ablations examine pointwise capacity, ordered-operator choice and training regularization (Table 5 ). Reconstruction-only Bi-CfC improves PSNR by 1.1444 dB over the 2D backbone. With the full objective, it exceeds the slice-independent MLP by 1.6185 dB in PSNR and 0.0111 in SSIM, with RMSE reduced by 0.0147, supporting propagation beyond pointwise capacity. Bi-GRU retains the same bidirectional context, full objective, initialization, insertion sites and training budget. Relative to this recurrent alternative, Bi-CfC improves PSNR by 0.0693 dB and SSIM by 0.0008, reduces RMSE by 0.0009, and has lower measured latency and memory use (Table 4 ). Together with the sampling comparison in Table 2 and the resource measurements in Table 4 , these results support Bi-CfC as the preferred sequence operator for ContiLNN under the evaluated conditions.
blocks.zh: 技术培训局对能力、有序操作者选择和培训正规化进行点入式检查(表5)。 仅重建的Bi-CfC改进了PSNR,比2D骨干改进了1.1444 dB. 在完全目标下,它比PSNR的切片独立的MLP多出1.6185分贝和SSIM多出0.0111分贝,RMSE减少0.0147分贝,支持超过点能的传播. Bi-GRU保留相同的双向环境,完全客观,初始化,插入站点和培训预算. 相对于这种经常性替代品,Bi-CfC将PSNR改进了0.0693分贝,SSIM改进了0.0008分贝,将RMSE减少0.0009分贝,并降低了测得的延迟和内存使用率(表4). 这些结果连同表2中的抽样比较和表4中的资源测量,支持了Bi-CfC作为ContiLNN在评价条件下的首选序列操作员.

blocks.en: Consistency and distillation provide a further improvement to Bi-CfC: the full objective adds 0.1702 dB in PSNR and 0.0013 in SSIM, while reducing RMSE by 0.0016. The broader architecture study supports selective insertion at intermediate and bottleneck features, with gated updates along the remaining pathways (Supplementary Section B). Component-wise loss analysis is provided in Section C, and sequence length is examined in Section D. The completed 2D training trajectory in Supplementary Section F documents the initialization used for refinement.

These changes associate restoration quality with both the locality and ordering of the supplied observations, with the larger deterioration following the removal of distinct local neighbors. blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Anatomical context and restoration
blocks.zh: 5.1 解剖学背景和恢复

blocks.en: Earlier restoration studies established complementary uses of adjacent slices through volumetric feature extraction and neighboring-slice supervision ( Shan et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ) . ContiLNN builds on this anatomical information through ordered feature propagation within a 2D restoration hierarchy. The PET ablations distinguish additional pointwise capacity from cross-slice propagation and compare two operators with the same bidirectional context. Context perturbations further show larger losses when distinct local neighbors are removed or replaced than when their order is reversed (Table 6 ). This pattern suggests that local anatomical content supplies an important source of information, with its ordering making an additional contribution to restoration fidelity.
blocks.zh: 早期的修复研究通过量子特征取出和相邻切片监督确定了相邻切片的补充用途(Shan等,2018;张等,2021). ContiLNN通过在2D恢复等级内有秩序地传播特征,利用这种解剖信息。 PET分解法将额外指针能力与相片传播区分开来,并将两个操作符与同一种双向上下文进行比较。 上下文扰动进一步表明,当当地不同的邻居被移除或取而代之时,损失会比其订单倒置时更大(表6)。 这种模式表明,当地解剖内容提供了一个重要的信息来源,其命令为恢复忠诚作出了额外贡献。

blocks.en: The two regularizers address different aspects of using this information. Reference-based differences encourage predictions to follow the intensity changes of the anatomical sequence, including transitions at tissue interfaces. Knowledge distillation transfers information through reference predictions ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) ; here, 2D backbone distillation uses a frozen, pretrained backbone to provide an in-plane reference as ContiLNN incorporates neighboring observations. Their complementary role is supported by the loss-component analysis in Supplementary Section C. The resulting design combines access to neighboring anatomy with supervision of how the restored sequence should vary.
blocks.zh: 两个常态化器处理使用这种信息的不同方面. 基于参考的差异鼓励预测跟踪解剖序列的强度变化,包括组织界面的过渡. 知识分馏通过参考预测传递信息(Hinton等,2015年;在这里,2D骨干分馏使用被冷冻,被预先训练的骨干来提供飞机中参考,因为ContiLNN包含了相邻观测. 补充部分C部分的损失部分分析支持了它们的补充作用。 由此产生的设计将访问相邻的解剖学与对恢复序列应如何变化的监督结合起来.

blocks.en: Across CT, MRI and PET, this combination improves fidelity under different degradation processes. Local image examples, orthogonal MRI views and intensity profiles relate the gains to anatomical interfaces and uptake transitions, while the MRI and PET case-level analyses show how those gains extend across the evaluated cohorts. Together, these results support local anatomical continuity as a useful source of complementary information for restoration.
blocks.zh: 在整个CT、核磁共振和PET中,这种结合在不同降解过程中提高了忠诚度。 局部图像实例、正交磁共振观点和强度剖面将收益与解剖界面和吸收过渡联系起来,而磁共振和磁共振和磁共振和磁共振和磁共振病例分析则显示这些收益如何扩展到被评价的组别。 这些结果共同支持了局部解剖连续性,作为修复的补充信息的有用来源.

blocks.en: 5.2 Sampling and efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.2 取样和效率

blocks.en: Restoration from incomplete image series requires using neighboring observations whose separation may vary along the slice axis. Retaining the original indices distinguishes consecutive slices from observations separated by omitted positions. CfC incorporates the resulting normalized index gaps into its closed-form state updates without iterative numerical integration ( Hasani et al., 2022 ) . Under the principal contiguous-training protocol, Bi-CfC maintains higher restoration fidelity than Bi-GRU across the tested sparse and irregular contexts. The mixed-gap study shows that broader sampling exposure benefits both operators, with closely matched performance under that training strategy. Together with lower measured latency and peak allocated memory than Bi-GRU, these findings support Bi-CfC as the preferred slice-axis operator for ContiLNN in the evaluated setting.
blocks.zh: 从不完整的图像序列中恢复,需要使用相邻的观测,其分离可能沿切片轴而有差异. 保留原始指数将连续切片与被省略位置分隔的观察区分开来. CfC将由此而来正常化的指数差距纳入封闭式状态更新,而不进行迭代数字整合(Hasani等人,2022年)。 根据主要毗连训练协议,Bi-CfC在经过试验的稀有和不规则情况下保持比Bi-GRU更高的恢复忠诚度。 混合差距研究显示,更广泛的取样接触对两个操作人员都有利,在这种培训战略下,其性能非常相配。 这些发现与比Bi-GRU更低的测得潜伏度和所分配的峰值内存一起,支持Bi-CfC作为ContiLNN在被评价的设置中首选的切片轴操作员.

blocks.en: The limited-patient PET experiments examine the value of the same context under constrained training data. Improvements at matched target-slice exposure indicate more effective use of the available observations. Additional refinement addresses a complementary setting by allocating further optimization to models trained on the same patients. The two settings connect sequence modeling with data efficiency while distinguishing the contribution obtained at a matched exposure budget from that obtained through continued training.
blocks.zh: 有限患者PET实验在受限制的培训数据下考察同一背景的价值. 相应的目标切片接触的改善表明,现有观测结果得到更有效的利用。 进一步的改进涉及一种补充环境,将进一步优化分配给对同一患者进行培训的模型。 这两种设置将序列模型与数据效率联系起来,同时将相应接触预算获得的贡献与通过持续培训获得的贡献区分开来。

blocks.en: Integration with Restore-RWKV and DASMamba ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Chan et al., 2026 ) separates in-plane representation learning from cross-slice information exchange. PSNR and RMSE gains with both backbones support this division of roles across the two tested architectures. Operator choice also affects the resources required for this exchange. Under the matched seven-slice, 32-bit NVIDIA A800 profiling conditions, Bi-CfC reduces median window latency by 52.8% and peak allocated memory by 57.0% relative to Bi-GRU, despite closely matched parameter counts and arithmetic costs (Table 4 ). The limited-patient and operator studies therefore identify complementary benefits in the use of training data and inference resources.
blocks.zh: 与RWKV和DASMamba合并 (杨等,2026a; Chan等, 2026) 将机上代表学习从交叉切片信息交流中分离出. PSNR和RMSE在两个骨干上都取得了收益,支持在两个经过测试的架构中划分角色。 运算符的选择也影响到这种交换所需的资源. 在匹配的7-silice,32位的NVIDIA A800剖面条件下,Bi-CfC将中位窗口延迟度减少52.8%并相对于Bi-GRU分配的内存高峰为57.0%,尽管参数计数和算术成本非常匹配(表4). 因此,有限的病人和操作人员研究确定了在使用培训数据和推断资源方面的互补效益。

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制

blocks.en: The current evidence is based on fixed restoration benchmarks and local slice windows. Physical slice-spacing metadata are unavailable in the preprocessed data used here, so the experiments assess index-defined sampling rather than adaptation to calibrated anatomical distances. Window length and index gaps jointly determine the anatomical extent of the available context.
blocks.zh: 目前的证据是基于固定的恢复基准和当地切片窗口. 物理切片相距元数据在此处使用的预处理数据中是不可用的,因此实验评估了指数定义的采样,而不是适应校正解剖距离. 窗口长度和索引差距共同决定了可用上下文的解剖范围.

blocks.en: The CT test partition contains one patient; the small variation across training seeds characterizes training repeatability on that patient rather than between-patient robustness. Generalization across acquisition protocols has not yet been evaluated. Adding slice-axis propagation also increases the parameter count and arithmetic cost relative to the original 2D backbone.
blocks.zh: CT测试分区包含一名病人;培训种子的细微差异是该病人的培训可重复性,而不是病人之间的强健性。 尚未对采购协议的通用性进行评价。 相较于原来的2D主干线,增加分片轴传播也增加了参数计数和算术成本.

blocks.en: 5.4 Future directions
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 未来方向

blocks.en: Physical slice coordinates derived from Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) metadata could connect the updates more directly to anatomical distance and acquisition geometry. Adaptive context lengths and selective propagation across feature levels could further match contextual exchange to sampling density and local anatomical variation. Comparisons with slice-axis convolution and attention under matched budgets would help characterize these choices. Evaluation across centers and acquisition protocols, together with downstream tasks and reader studies, would extend the assessment of restoration quality to broader imaging workflows. By improving the quality of available slices while preserving their original positions, ContiLNN may help recover useful anatomical information from incomplete image series in retrospective clinical workflows.
blocks.zh: 从医学中的数字成像和通信(DICOM)元数据衍生出来的物理切片坐标可以更直接地将更新与解剖距离和获取几何相接. 适应性上下文长度和不同地物水平的选择性传播可进一步使上下文交换与取样密度和局部解剖变化相匹配。 与分轴结构的比较以及相应预算下的关注将有助于确定这些选择的特点。 各中心的评价和采购协议,连同下游任务和读者研究,将恢复质量评估扩大到更广泛的成像工作流程。 通过提高可用切片的质量,同时保留其原始位置,ContiLNN可能有助于从回顾性临床工作流程中的不完整图像序列中恢复有用的解剖信息.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: ContiLNN augments two-dimensional medical image restoration with bidirectional liquid dynamics over ordered slice positions. Slice-index intervals condition state propagation on the supplied sampling, while joint restoration preserves an output for every observed slice. Experiments across CT, MRI and PET demonstrate improved fidelity. Experiments with limited paired training cohorts (5% and 10% of PET training patients) and a second restoration backbone (DASMamba) support data efficiency and architectural compatibility, while the PET ablations support ordered propagation and complementary regularization. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than Bi-GRU across the tested sampling conditions, alongside lower measured inference latency and peak allocated memory. Additional mixed-gap experiments show that broader sampling exposure can improve both operators. These findings support Bi-CfC as the preferred operator in the evaluated ContiLNN framework and liquid dynamics as a practical approach to incorporating anatomical continuity into 2D restoration networks.
blocks.zh: ContiLNN通过双向液体动力学在所订购的切片位置上增强二维医学图像修复. 剪切-索引间隔条件在提供的取样中呈传播状态,而联合恢复则保持每个被观测到的切片的输出. 跨CT、核磁共振和PET的实验表明,忠贞性有所提高。 有限的对等培训组群的实验(占PET培训病人的5%和10%)和第二个恢复骨干(DASMamba)支持数据效率和建筑兼容性,而PET活化支持则命令进行传播和补充规范化。 在相接训练下,Bi-CfC在经过测试的采样条件下实现比Bi-GRU更高的忠诚度,同时测量出较低的推论延后性和所分配的顶峰内存. 额外的混合差距实验表明,更广泛的取样接触可以改善两种操作人员。 这些调查结果支持Bi-CfC作为受评价的ContiLNN框架和液体动力学的首选操作者,作为将解剖连续性纳入2D恢复网络的实用方法.

blocks.en: A.4 Sampling robustness
blocks.zh: A.4 取样稳健性

blocks.en: The PET sampling study compares Bi-CfC and Bi-GRU under contiguous and mixed-gap training. For each operator, the mixed-gap configuration retains the backbone initialization, insertion sites, objective, optimization settings and training budget of its contiguous-training counterpart. Each mixed-gap training window uses a constant gap selected from { 1 , 2 , 3 } \{1,2,3\} . The three gaps contribute approximately equal numbers of windows, while the total windows and optimizer updates per epoch match contiguous training. A seven-observation window spans 7, 13, or 19 original slice positions for gaps 1, 2, or 3, respectively. Validation uses consecutive slices with the original two-tiling fusion. Sparse testing uses interleaved slice sequences, and irregular testing combines overlapping windows. All eligible original target slices are retained for evaluation across sampling conditions, with case-level metrics computed over the same test cohort. Mixed-gap training uses 16-bit mixed precision with a fixed loss scale of 128 and gradient clipping at 1.0. Complete results for both training strategies are reported in Section H .

H节报告了这两项培训战略的全部结果。

blocks.en: A.5 Data efficiency
blocks.zh: A.5 数据效率

blocks.en: The PET data-efficiency experiments use training seed 42 and nested subsets of 6 and 12 patients, corresponding to 5% and 10% of the 120 training patients. The validation and test cohorts remain fixed. A slice presentation is counted whenever one target slice contributes to training; this makes the exposure budget comparable between independent-slice and sequence training.
blocks.zh: PET数据效率实验使用训练种子42并嵌入了6个和12个病人的子集,相当于120个训练病人的5%和10%. 验证组和测试组保持不变。 每当一个目标片有助于培训时,即进行片面介绍;这使得接触预算在独立片段培训和序列培训之间具有可比性。

blocks.en: Restore-RWKV receives 1.2 million slice presentations from random initialization. Budget-matched ContiLNN uses 0.6 million presentations for the 2D pathway, then activates Bi-CfC for a further 0.6 million presentations. The transition uses the checkpoint at that fixed exposure, with a frozen copy supplying the distillation targets during sequence training. Full refinement starts from the ratio-matched Restore-RWKV checkpoint after its 1.2-million-presentation schedule and adds a sequence-training budget derived from the full-data refinement schedule.
blocks.zh: Return-RWKV接收了从随机初始化得到的120万个片面演示. 与预算相匹配的ContiLNN在2D路径中使用了60万个演示文稿,然后激活了再使用60万个演示文稿的Bi-CfC. 过渡时使用该固定暴露处的检查站,在序列训练时用冷冻拷贝提供蒸馏目标。 全面完善始于120万份介绍表之后的比例匹配的RWKV检查站,并增加了根据全面数据完善表得出的序列培训预算。

blocks.en: Both sequence-training strategies use AdamW, a global batch of three sequences, and peak learning rates of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for backbone and Bi-CfC parameters and 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for gates. The learning rates warm up over the first 5% of the sequence-training exposure and then decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Consistency and distillation weights increase linearly over the first 10% to 0.30 and 0.05, respectively; the second-order consistency weight is 2.0. The complete ContiLNN model remains trainable. Training uses a fixed mixed-precision loss scale of 128, gradient clipping at 1.0, and no early stopping. These schedules are indexed by slice exposure rather than epoch count.

blocks.en: A.7 Computational profiling
blocks.zh: A.7 计算特征分析

blocks.en: Inference is profiled on an NVIDIA A800 GPU using 32-bit floating-point precision and 128 × 128 128\times 128 images. The baseline processes a batch of seven independent slices, while the Bi-CfC, MLP and Bi-GRU variants each process one window of seven slices. Timing is measured after 20 warm-up passes and summarized by the median of 100 repetitions, with GPU synchronization around each repetition. Per-slice latency and arithmetic cost are obtained by dividing the window totals by seven. These latencies measure an amortized model forward pass; they exclude data loading, window assembly and the overlapping-tiling fusion used for full-volume restoration. Peak allocated memory is recorded after warm-up; memory values labelled MB use 2 20 2^{20} bytes. One GMAC denotes 10 9 10^{9} multiply–accumulate operations. Peak reserved memory is 1,168 MB for Bi-CfC, 2,692 MB for the pointwise MLP and 3,000 MB for Bi-GRU; the main table reports allocated memory for all models. The Bi-GRU and Bi-CfC variants contain 34.50 and 34.52 million trainable parameters, respectively, of which 6.54 and 6.55 million belong to their ordered operators. Their median seven-slice window latencies are 380.92 and 179.85 ms, respectively.

blocks.en: These results identify mixed-gap training as a complementary strategy for restoration with partially available neighboring context. The benefit extends to both sequence operators, indicating that exposure to varied training gaps contributes to the observed adaptation.
